keyart: Pitch a movie title and the posters that make this an EPIC film release, and that open a curiosity gap a stranger must close by watching. Prefer one unforgettable graphic idea per poster over a busy scene. At least one poster must make the BLOCK (the raised hand / the wall of grown-ups) the hero; at least one must use a bold graphic trick (silhouette, scale, negative space, split, shadow, or a single small child against something huge).
